rūpāni hi kho kho tasmiṃ samaye (sī. ka.) passāmi na ca obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi – kevalampi rattiṃ, kevalampi divaṃ, kevalampi rattindiva’nti. tassa mayhaṃ, anuruddhā, etadahosi – ‘yasmiñhi kho ahaṃ samaye rūpanimittaṃ amanasikaritvā obhāsanimittaṃ manasi karomi, obhāsañhi kho tasmiṃ samaye sañjānāmi, na ca rūpāni passāmi. yasmiṃ panāhaṃ samaye obhāsanimittaṃ amanasikaritvā rūpanimittaṃ manasi karomi, rūpāni hi kho tasmiṃ samaye passāmi na ca obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi – kevalampi rattiṃ, kevalampi divaṃ, kevalampi rattindiva’’’nti. 243. “阿那律，我确实不放逸、热忱、精勤而住，只了知光明，而不见诸色；只见诸色，而不了知光明——于一整夜、一整日，乃至一整日夜。阿那律，我当时心生此念：‘是何因、何缘，使我只了知光明，而不见诸色；只见诸色，而不了知光明——于一整夜、一整日，乃至一整日夜呢？’阿那律，我复生此念：‘当我于某时，不作意色相而作意光明相，彼时我便只了知光明，而不见诸色。当我于某时，不作意光明相而作意色相，彼时我便只见诸色，而不了知光明——于一整夜、一整日，乃至一整日夜。’” 243. so i, anuruddhas, dwelling diligent, ardent, and resolute, perceive light, but i do not see forms; i see forms, but i do not perceive light—for the entire night, for the entire day, for the entire night and day. then, anuruddhas, it occurred to me: ‘what is the cause, what is the reason, that i perceive light but do not see forms; i see forms but do not perceive light—for the entire night, for the entire day, for the entire night and day?’ then, anuruddhas, it occurred to me: ‘at the time when i do not attend to the sign of forms but attend to the sign of light, at that time i perceive light, but i do not see forms. but at the time when i do not attend to the sign of light but attend to the sign of forms, at that time i see forms, but i do not perceive light—for the entire night, for the entire day, for the entire night and day.’ obhāsa nimitta mn128 obhasa nimitta

ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha. ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ. pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma – ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīlānussatiṃ bhāveti’’’. 再者，摩诃男，圣弟子随念自己的戒：其戒是不毁坏的、不残缺的、无斑点的、无瑕疵的、自在的、为智者所称赞的、不被执取的、导向禅定的。摩诃男，当圣弟子随念于戒时，那时他的心不为贪欲所困扰，不为瞋恚所困扰，不为愚痴所困扰；那时，他的心缘于戒而变得正直。摩诃男，心正直的圣弟子获得义悦，获得法悦，获得与法相应的欢悦。欢悦者生起喜；有喜心者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入定。摩诃男，这被称为：‘圣弟子在不平等的众生中住于平等，在有瞋恼的众生中住于无瞋恼，入于法流，修习戒随念。’ “furthermore, mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects his own virtues: that they are unbroken, unbreached, unspotted, unblotched, liberating, praised by the wise, unmisapprehended, and conducive to concentration. when, mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects his virtues, at that time his mind is not overcome by lust, not overcome by hatred, and not overcome by delusion; at that time his mind is upright, based on virtue. with an upright mind, mahānāma, the noble disciple gains inspiration in the meaning, gains inspiration in the dhamma, gains joy connected with the dhamma. when he is joyful, rapture arises. for one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. one tranquil in body feels pleasure. the mind of one who is pleased becomes concentrated. this, mahānāma, is called: ‘a noble disciple who dwells peacefully among a turbulent populace, who dwells without affliction among an afflicted populace, who has entered the stream of the dhamma and develops the recollection of virtues.’” ārammaṇa anussarati mn62 an6.10 mn118 mn10 sn46.54 arammana anussarati

iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharatha. karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ karuṇāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharatha. muditāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ muditāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharatha. upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharathā’’’ti. “贤友们，沙门乔达摩对弟子们如是说法：‘来，比丘们，你们当舍断心的随烦恼、令慧羸弱的五盖（pañca nīvaraṇe），以慈俱心（mettāsahagatena cetasā）遍满一方而住；如是第二方，如是第三方，如是第四方；如是，上、下、横，于一切处，视一切如己，以广大、崇高、无量、无怨、无害的慈俱心，遍满这包含一切的世界而住。以悲俱心（karuṇāsahagatena cetasā）遍满一方而住；如是第二方，如是第三方，如是第四方；如是，上、下、横，于一切处，视一切如己，以广大、崇高、无量、无怨、无害的悲俱心，遍满这包含一切的世界而住。以喜俱心（muditāsahagatena cetasā）遍满一方而住；如是第二方，如是第三方，如是第四方；如是，上、下、横，于一切处，视一切如己，以广大、崇高、无量、无怨、无害的喜俱心，遍满这包含一切的世界而住。以舍俱心（upekkhāsahagatena cetasā）遍满一方而住；如是第二方，如是第三方，如是第四方；如是，上、下、横，于一切处，视一切如己，以广大、崇高、无量、无怨、无害的舍俱心，遍满这包含一切的世界而住。’” “friends, the ascetic gotama teaches the dhamma to his disciples thus: ‘come, monks, having abandoned the five hindrances, which are defilements of the mind and cause the weakening of wisdom, dwell pervading one direction with a mind accompanied by loving-kindness; likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. thus, above, below, and across, everywhere, for all as for oneself, dwell pervading the entire world with a mind accompanied by loving-kindness—vast, exalted, immeasurable, without enmity, and without ill will. dwell pervading one direction with a mind accompanied by compassion; likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. thus, above, below, and across, everywhere, for all as for oneself, dwell pervading the entire world with a mind accompanied by compassion—vast, exalted, immeasurable, without enmity, and without ill will. dwell pervading one direction with a mind accompanied by sympathetic joy; likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. thus, above, below, and across, everywhere, for all as for oneself, dwell pervading the entire world with a mind accompanied by sympathetic joy—vast, exalted, immeasurable, without enmity, and without ill will. dwell pervading one direction with a mind accompanied by equanimity; likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. thus, above, below, and across, everywhere, for all as for oneself, dwell pervading the entire world with a mind accompanied by equanimity—vast, exalted, immeasurable, without enmity, and without ill will.’” 四无量入门 mn62 sn46.54 无量

nodes.s: v4m-022-初禅 初禅 初禅 定、禅那与定境 legacy_spine 离欲离不善法；有寻有伺，离生喜乐 dn2 戒蕴品 sīlakkhandhavaggapāḷi 226 . ‘‘so vivicceva kāmehi, vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. 226. 那位比丘远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，成就并安住于有寻、有伺、由远离而生的喜与乐的初禅。他以此由远离而生的喜与乐浸润、浸透、充满、遍满此身，其全身没有任何一处不被由远离而生的喜与乐所遍满。 226. quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, he enters and dwells in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, with rapture and pleasure born of seclusion. he drenches, steeps, fills, and pervades this very body with the rapture and pleasure born of seclusion, so that there is no part of his entire body unpervaded by the rapture and pleasure born of seclusion. 初禅 dn2 sn40.1 初禅

nodes.note: 离喜住舍；正念正知，身受乐

nodes.title: 第四禅
nodes.note: 舍苦乐；不苦不乐，舍念清净
nodes.s: v4m-025-第四禅 第四禅 第四禅 定、禅那与定境 legacy_spine 舍苦乐；不苦不乐，舍念清净 dn2 戒蕴品 sīlakkhandhavaggapāḷi 232 . ‘‘puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti. 232. 再者，大王，比丘由于舍断乐与舍断苦，以及先前喜悦与忧恼的灭尽，进入并安住于不苦不乐、由舍而念清净的第四禅。他以清净、明亮的心遍满此身而坐，其全身无一处不为清净、明亮的心所遍满。 232. furthermore, great king, a monk, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and sorrow, enters and abides in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and is characterized by purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. he sits having pervaded this very body with a pure, bright mind, so that there is no part of his entire body unpervaded by the pure, bright mind. 第四禅 dn2 sn40.4 第四禅 第四 四禅

nodes.s: v4m-029-空无边处 空无边处 空无边处 定、禅那与定境 legacy_spine 超越色想，作意无边空 sn40.6 六处品 saḷāyatanavaggapāḷi 337 . ‘‘‘viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ, viññāṇañcāyatana’nti vuccati. katamaṃ nu kho viññāṇañcāyatananti? tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, etadahosi – ‘idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. idaṃ vuccati viññāṇañcāyatana’nti. so khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi . tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato ākāsānañcāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti. 337. “‘识无边处，识无边处’，如是说。那么，什么是识无边处呢？贤友，我曾作是念：‘在此，比丘完全超越空无边处，思惟“识无边”，证入并安住于识无边处。这被称为识无边处。’贤友，我确实完全超越空无边处，思惟‘识无边’，证入并安住于识无边处。贤友，我如是住时，与空无边处相应的想与作意生起。” 337. “‘the sphere of infinite consciousness, the sphere of infinite consciousness,’ it is said. what, then, is the sphere of infinite consciousness? then, friends, this thought occurred to me: ‘here, a bhikkhu, having entirely transcended the sphere of infinite space, (perceiving) “consciousness is infinite,” enters and abides in the sphere of infinite consciousness. this is called the sphere of infinite consciousness.’ and so, friends, having entirely transcended the sphere of infinite space, (perceiving) ‘consciousness is infinite,’ i enter and abide in the sphere of infinite consciousness. friends, as i was dwelling in this abiding, perceptions and acts of attention associated with the sphere of infinite space assailed me. 空无边处 mn106 sn40.5 sn40.6 空无边处 空无 无边 边处

'do not say so, ānanda! do not say so, ānanda! profound, ānanda, is this dependent origination, and profound it appears. it is through not understanding, through not penetrating this dhamma, that this generation has become like a tangled skein of thread, like a knotted ball of thread, like matted muñja and babbaja grass, and does not transcend the state of loss, the bad destination, the downfall, this saṃsāra.' 缘起观 sn12.23 dn15 缘起

ekatta’nti. iti yañhi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ ‘santamidaṃ atthī’ti pajānāti. evampissa esā, ānanda , yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati. 178. 再者，阿难，比丘不作意林野想，不作意地想，而是依空无边处想作意于一性。他的心倾入、澄净、安住、胜解于空无边处想。他这样了知：‘那些依林野想而生的忧恼，在这里没有；那些依地想而生的忧恼，在这里没有；唯有此量之忧恼，即依空无边处想而有的一性。’他了知：‘此想的境界空于林野想’，了知：‘此想的境界空于地想’，了知：‘有此不空，即：依空无边处想而有的一性。’如是，凡于彼处所无者，他视之为空；凡于彼处所存者，他了知：‘此是存在的。’阿难，如是于他，此乃如实、不颠倒、清净的空性之进入。 178. furthermore, ānanda, a bhikkhu, not attending to the perception of the wilderness, not attending to the perception of earth, attends to the singularity dependent on the perception of the dimension of infinite space. his mind leaps up at, grows confident in, settles upon, and becomes resolved on the perception of the dimension of infinite space. he understands thus: ‘whatever disturbances might exist dependent on the perception of the wilderness are not present here. whatever disturbances might exist dependent on the perception of earth are not present here. there is only this measure of disturbance, namely, the singularity dependent on the perception of the dimension of infinite space.’ he understands: ‘this field of perception is empty of the perception of the wilderness.’ he understands: ‘this field of perception is empty of the perception of earth.’ he understands: ‘there is only this non-emptiness, namely, the singularity dependent on the perception of the dimension of infinite space.’ thus, he regards it as empty of whatever is not there. but of what remains there, he understands that it is present: ‘this is present.’ in this way, ānanda, this becomes for him a genuine, undistorted, and pure entry into emptiness. 空性观 mn121 mn122 空性

nodes.s: v4m-050-三相深入 三相深入 三相深入 观察、洞见与转向 legacy_spine 无常、有为、缘生；不可主宰故非我 an9.36 九集 navakanipātapāḷi ‘‘dutiyampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, jhānaṃ nissāya…pe… tatiyampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, jhānaṃ nissāya… ‘catutthampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati – ‘etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbāna’nti. so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā. “诸比丘，我依止第二禅……乃至……我依止第三禅……乃至……‘诸比丘，我依止第四禅而说诸漏的灭尽。’此话是这样说的，此乃依何而说呢？诸比丘，于此，有比丘舍乐、舍苦，先已灭除喜、忧，进入并安住于不苦不乐、舍念清净的第四禅。他对其中所有色、受、想、行、识等法，皆观为无常、苦、病、痈、箭、灾、疾、他、坏、空、无我。他令心于彼等法生起厌离。他令心于彼等法生起厌离后，将心导向不死界：‘此乃寂静，此乃殊胜，即一切行之止息，一切依之舍离，爱尽、离贪、灭、涅槃。’他安住于此，便证得诸漏灭尽。若未证得诸漏灭尽，则因对彼法之贪与喜，五下分结断尽，成为化生者，于彼界般涅槃，不复从彼世间返回。” ‘bhikkhus, i declare the destruction of the taints by relying on the second jhāna… and so on… by relying on the third jhāna… ‘bhikkhus, i declare the destruction of the taints by relying on the fourth jhāna.’ indeed, this was said. and in reference to what was it said? here, bhikkhus, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and displeasure, a bhikkhu enters and abides in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. he thoroughly contemplates whatever phenomena are comprised therein—included in form, feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness—as impermanent, as suffering, as a disease, as a boil, as a dart, as misery, as an affliction, as alien, as disintegrating, as empty, as not-self. he turns his mind away from those phenomena. having turned his mind away from them, he directs his mind to the deathless element: ‘this is peaceful, this is sublime, namely, the stilling of all formations, the relinquishing of all substrates of existence, the destruction of craving, dispassion, cessation, nibbāna.’ established therein, he attains the destruction of the taints. if he does not attain the destruction of the taints, then through that very passion for the dhamma and that delight in the dhamma, with the utter destruction of the five lower fetters, he is one of spontaneous birth, who will attain final nibbāna there, not subject to returning from that world. anicca anattā sn22.59 an9.36 anicca anatta

nodes.s: v4m-070-瞋恚 瞋恚 障碍、辨识与对治 atomic_member sn46.51 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, mettācetovimutti. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya. “诸比丘，对于未生起的瞋恚(byāpāda)之生起，以及已生起的瞋恚之增长、广大，其非食为何？诸比丘，有慈心解脱(mettācetovimutti)。于此，多多如理作意——此即是对于未生起的瞋恚之生起，以及已生起的瞋恚之增长、广大之非食。” and what, bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, or for the increase and abundance of arisen ill will? there is, bhikkhus, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness. therein, the frequent practice of wise attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, or for the increase and abundance of arisen ill will. 瞋恚 byāpāda sn46.51 an5.23 瞋恚 byapada

nodes.title: 昏沉与睡眠
nodes.s: v4m-071-昏沉与睡眠 昏沉与睡眠 障碍、辨识与对治 atomic_member sn46.51 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, arati tandi vijambhitā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ. tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya. “诸比丘，什么是未生起的昏沉睡眠（thīnamiddha）生起，已生起的昏沉睡眠增长、广大的食呢？诸比丘，有不乐（arati）、倦怠（tandi）、呵欠（vijambhitā）、饭后昏沉（bhattasammada）与心的萎靡（cetaso līnatta）。于彼，多修不如理作意——此即是未生起的昏沉睡眠生起，已生起的昏沉睡眠增长、广大的食。” “and what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, and for the increase and expansion of arisen sloth and torpor? there are, monks, discontent, languor, yawning, drowsiness after a meal, and sluggishness of mind. in regard to these, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, and for the increase and expansion of arisen sloth and torpor. 昏沉 thīna sn46.51 an5.23 昏沉 thina

nodes.title: 掉举与悔
nodes.s: v4m-072-掉举与悔 掉举与悔 障碍、辨识与对治 atomic_member sn46.51 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, cetaso avūpasamo. tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya. “诸比丘，什么是未生起的掉举恶作（uddhaccakukkucca）生起，已生起的掉举恶作增长、广大的食呢？诸比丘，有心的不寂静（cetaso avūpasama）。于彼，多修不如理作意——此即是未生起的掉举恶作生起，已生起的掉举恶作增长、广大的食。” “and what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, and for the increase and expansion of arisen restlessness and remorse? there is, monks, an unquieted state of mind. in regard to that, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, and for the increase and expansion of arisen restlessness and remorse. 掉举 uddhacca sn46.51 an5.23 掉举 uddhacca

nodes.title: 疑盖
nodes.s: v4m-073-疑盖 疑盖 障碍、辨识与对治 atomic_member sn46.51 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, vicikicchāṭṭhānīyā dhammā. tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya. “诸比丘，什么是能令未生起的疑生起，或令已生起的疑增长、广大的食？诸比丘，有作为疑之根据的诸法。于彼，多作不如理作意——此即是能令未生起的疑生起，或令已生起的疑增长、广大的食。” “and what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, and for the increase and expansion of arisen doubt? there are, monks, things that are a basis for doubt. in regard to them, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, and for the increase and expansion of arisen doubt. 疑 vicikicchā sn46.51 an5.23 vicikiccha

‘parabyābādhāya saṃvattatī’tipi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati; ‘ubhayabyābādhāya saṃvattatī’tipi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati; ‘paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko’tipi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati. so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, uppannuppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ pajahameva atītakālikakiriyāpadāniyeva vinodameva atītakālikakiriyāpadāniyeva byantameva byanteva (sī. syā. pī.) naṃ akāsiṃ. 207. “诸比丘，我如是不放逸、热忱、专心致志而住时，生起了欲寻。我这样了知：‘我这欲寻已生起。它既导致恼害自己，也导致恼害他人，还导致恼害双方；它障碍智慧，属于恼害的一方，不导向涅槃。’诸比丘，当我反思‘它导致恼害自己’时，它就消失了；诸比丘，当我反思‘它导致恼害他人’时，它就消失了；诸比丘，当我反思‘它导致恼害双方’时，它就消失了；诸比丘，当我反思‘它障碍智慧，属于恼害的一方，不导向涅槃’时，它就消失了。诸比丘，我就是这样，对每一个生起的欲寻，都予以舍断、去除、灭尽。” 207. “monks, as i was dwelling thus—heedful, ardent, and resolute—a thought of sensual desire arose in me. i understood it thus: ‘this thought of sensual desire has arisen in me. it leads to my own affliction, to the affliction of others, and to the affliction of both; it obstructs wisdom, is on the side of distress, and does not lead to nibbāna.’ as i reflected, ‘it leads to my own affliction,’ it subsided in me. as i reflected, ‘it leads to the affliction of others,’ it subsided in me. as i reflected, ‘it leads to the affliction of both,’ it subsided in me. as i reflected, ‘it obstructs wisdom, is on the side of distress, and does not lead to nibbāna,’ it subsided in me. monks, i would abandon, dispel, and make an end of each thought of sensual desire as it arose. 欲寻 kāmavitakka mn19 mn20 欲寻 kamavitakka

nodes.title: 慈
nodes.s: v4m-077-慈 慈 所缘与入门 atomic_member sn46.54 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘evaṃvādino, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā – ‘kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso, mettācetovimutti, kiṃgatikā hoti, kiṃparamā, kiṃphalā, kiṃpariyosānā? kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso, karuṇācetovimutti, kiṃgatikā hoti, kiṃparamā, kiṃphalā, kiṃpariyosānā? kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso, muditācetovimutti, kiṃgatikā hoti, kiṃparamā, kiṃphalā, kiṃpariyosānā? kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso, upekkhācetovimutti, kiṃgatikā hoti, kiṃparamā, kiṃphalā, kiṃpariyosānā’’’ti? evaṃ puṭṭhā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti, uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. taṃ kissa hetu? yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ. ‘‘nāhaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā’’. “诸比丘，对那些持此论的外道游行者，应当这样说：‘贤友，慈心解脱(mettācetovimutti)如何修习？它有何归趋？以何为最上？有何果报？以何为终极？贤友，悲心解脱(karuṇācetovimutti)如何修习？它有何归趋？以何为最上？有何果报？以何为终极？贤友，喜心解脱(muditācetovimutti)如何修习？它有何归趋？以何为最上？有何果报？以何为终极？贤友，舍心解脱(upekkhācetovimutti)如何修习？它有何归趋？以何为最上？有何果报？以何为终极？’诸比丘，当外道游行者被这样问时，他们将无法圆满回答，而且会更增窘迫。那是什么原因呢？诸比丘，因为这并非他们的境界。诸比丘，于这包含天、魔、梵天的世界，于这包含沙门、婆罗门、天与人的众生中，除了如来、如来的弟子，或从此处听闻者之外，我未见到有谁能以解答这些问题而令人心满意足。” “monks, when wanderers of other sects speak thus, they should be addressed as follows: ‘how, friends, is the liberation of mind by loving-kindness cultivated? what is its destination, what its supreme state, what its fruit, what its culmination? how, friends, is the liberation of mind by compassion cultivated? what is its destination, what its supreme state, what its fruit, what its culmination? how, friends, is the liberation of mind by appreciative joy cultivated? what is its destination, what its supreme state, what its fruit, what its culmination? how, friends, is the liberation of mind by equanimity cultivated? what is its destination, what its supreme state, what its fruit, what its culmination?’ when asked thus, monks, those wanderers of other sects will not be able to answer and will, moreover, fall into vexation. for what reason? because, monks, it is beyond their domain. monks, i do not see anyone in this world with its devas, its māra, and its brahmās, in this generation with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans, who could satisfy the mind with an explanation of these questions, except for the tathāgata or a disciple of the tathāgata, or one who has heard it from this source.” 慈心 mettā mn62 sn46.54 慈心 metta

nodes.s: v4m-085-体验喜 体验喜 修习框架与能力 atomic_member mn118 后五十经 uparipaṇṇāsapāḷi ‘‘āraddhavīriyassa uppajjati pīti nirāmisā. yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno āraddhavīriyassa uppajjati pīti nirāmisā, pītisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, pītisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. 已发起精进者，生起无染之喜。诸比丘，于何时，已发起精进的比丘生起无染之喜，于彼时，比丘的喜觉支(pītisambojjhaṅga)已被发起；于彼时，比丘修习喜觉支；于彼时，比丘的喜觉支到达修习圆满。 for one with aroused energy, unworldly rapture arises. when, monks, unworldly rapture arises for a monk with aroused energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture is initiated for him. at that time, the monk develops the enlightenment factor of rapture, and for him the enlightenment factor of rapture goes to fulfillment by development. 喜 pīti mn118 sn54.13 piti

nodes.s: v4m-089-体验心 体验心 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn54.13 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu ‘cittappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘cittappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ…pe… samādahaṃ cittaṃ…pe… ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati – citte cittānupassī, ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu? nāhaṃ, ānanda, muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ānāpānassatisamādhibhāvanaṃ vadāmi. tasmātihānanda, citte cittānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. “阿难，当比丘学‘我将体验心而出息’，学‘我将体验心而入息’；令心喜悦……乃至……令心入定……乃至……学‘我将令心解脱而出息’，学‘我将令心解脱而入息’时——阿难，那时比丘于心随观心而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。此是何因？阿难，对失念、不正知者，我不说有入出息念定的修习。是故，阿难，那时比丘于心随观心而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。” “ānanda, at a time when a bhikkhu trains, thinking: ‘i will breathe out experiencing the mind,’ and ‘i will breathe in experiencing the mind’; … ‘i will breathe out gladdening the mind,’ … ‘i will breathe out concentrating the mind,’ … ‘i will breathe out liberating the mind,’ and ‘i will breathe in liberating the mind’—at that time, ānanda, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the mind in the mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. for what reason? i do not say, ānanda, that the development of concentration through mindfulness of breathing is for one who is unmindful and lacks clear comprehension. therefore, ānanda, at that time a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the mind in the mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.” 体验心 cittaṃ mn118 sn54.13 体验心 体验 验心 cittam

nodes.s: v4m-097-念觉支 念觉支 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn46.2 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā. 诸比丘，什么是能令未生之念觉支生起，或令已生之念觉支修习圆满之食呢？诸比丘，有作为念觉支之依处的诸法。于彼处，多作如理作意——此即是能令未生之念觉支生起，或令已生之念觉支修习圆满之食。 and what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness? there are, monks, things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of mindfulness. therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness. 念觉支 satisambojjhaṅga sn46.2 sn46.51 念觉支 念觉 觉支 satisambojjhanga

nodes.title: 择法觉支
nodes.s: v4m-098-择法觉支 择法觉支 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn46.2 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, kusalākusalā dhammā, sāvajjānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā. 诸比丘，什么是能令未生之择法觉支生起，或令已生之择法觉支修习圆满之食呢？诸比丘，有善与不善法、有罪与无罪法、下劣与胜妙法、黑白有对法。于彼处，多作如理作意——此即是能令未生之择法觉支生起，或令已生之择法觉支修习圆满之食。 and what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena? there are, monks, phenomena that are wholesome and unwholesome, blameworthy and blameless, inferior and superior, counterparts to the dark and the bright. therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena. 择法觉支 dhammavicaya sn46.2 sn46.51 择法觉支 择法 法觉 觉支 dhammavicaya

nodes.title: 精进觉支
nodes.s: v4m-099-精进觉支 精进觉支 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn46.51 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu. tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā. “诸比丘，什么是不令未生之精进觉支生起，或不令已生之精进觉支修习圆满的非食？诸比丘，有发动界、出离界、精勤界。于此，多不作意——这即是不令未生之精进觉支生起，或不令已生之精进觉支修习圆满的非食。” and what, bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy? there are, bhikkhus, the element of initiative, the element of setting forth, and the element of striving. therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy. 精进觉支 viriya sn46.2 sn46.51 精进觉支 精进 进觉 觉支 viriya

nodes.s: v4m-105-断除已生恶 断除已生恶 修习框架与能力 atomic_member an4.14 四集 catukkanipātapāḷi ‘‘katamañca, bhikkhave, pahānappadhānaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti; uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ…pe… uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ…pe… uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, pahānappadhānaṃ. “诸比丘，什么是断除精进呢？诸比丘，在此，比丘对已生起的欲寻(kāmavitakka)不容忍，舍弃、去除、灭除、令其不存在；对已生起的瞋寻……对已生起的害寻……对已生起的种种恶不善法不容忍，舍弃、去除、灭除、令其不存在。诸比丘，这称为断除精进。” “and what, bhikkhus, is the striving of abandoning? here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu does not tolerate an arisen sensual thought; he abandons it, dispels it, brings it to an end, and causes it to go to non-existence. he does not tolerate an arisen thought of ill will… an arisen thought of harming… he does not tolerate any arisen evil, unwholesome states; he abandons them, dispels them, brings them to an end, and causes them to go to non-existence. this, bhikkhus, is called the striving of abandoning. 已生恶 uppannā sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 已生 uppanna

nodes.s: v4m-110-心神足 心神足 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn51.20 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘kathañca , bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ālokasaññā suggahitā hoti divāsaññā svādhiṭṭhitā. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. “诸比丘，比丘如何以敞开、无覆之心修习光明之心？诸比丘，于此，比丘善受持光明想，善安立白昼想。诸比丘，比丘如此以敞开、无覆之心修习光明之心。” and how, monks, does a monk develop a luminous mind with a mind that is open and unenveloped? here, monks, a monk's perception of light is well grasped, and the perception of daytime is well established. in this way, monks, a monk develops a luminous mind with a mind that is open and unenveloped. 心 citta sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 citta

nodes.title: 信根
nodes.s: v4m-112-信根 信根 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn48.10 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) 480 . ‘‘pañcimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. katamāni pañca? saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ. katamañca, bhikkhave, saddhindriyaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saddhindriyaṃ. 480. “诸比丘，有此五根。是哪五个呢？信根……乃至……慧根。诸比丘，什么是信根呢？诸比丘，于此，圣弟子有信心，他相信如来的觉悟：‘彼世尊是阿罗汉、正自觉者、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上调御丈夫、天人导师、佛陀、世尊。’诸比丘，这被称为信根。” 480. monks, there are these five faculties. which five? the faculty of faith... the faculty of wisdom. and what, monks, is the faculty of faith? here, monks, a noble disciple has faith; he places his faith in the tathāgata’s enlightenment: ‘indeed, the blessed one is an arahant, perfectly enlightened, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, the well-gone, knower of the world, an unsurpassed trainer of persons to be tamed, teacher of gods and humans, the enlightened one, the blessed one.’ this, monks, is called the faculty of faith. 信根 saddhindriya sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 信根 saddhindriya

nodes.title: 精进根
nodes.s: v4m-113-精进根 精进根 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn48.10 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘katamañca , bhikkhave, vīriyindriyaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. so anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā samāpattiyā (syā. kaṃ. ka.) asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, vīriyindriyaṃ. “诸比丘，什么是精进根呢？诸比丘，于此，圣弟子为断除不善法、为具足善法而住于发起精进，于诸善法，强力、勇猛、不舍其轭。他为使未生之恶不善法不生而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤；为断除已生之恶不善法而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤；为使未生之善法生起而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤；为使已生之善法住立、不忘、增长、广大、修习、圆满而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤。诸比丘，这被称为精进根。” “and what, bhikkhus, is the faculty of energy? here, bhikkhus, a noble disciple dwells with energy aroused for abandoning unwholesome qualities and for acquiring wholesome qualities; he is strong, firm in exertion, not laying down the burden in regard to wholesome qualities. he generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the non-arising of unarisen evil, unwholesome qualities. he generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the abandoning of arisen evil, unwholesome qualities. he generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the arising of unarisen wholesome qualities. he generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the maintenance, non-confusion, increase, expansion, development, and fulfillment of arisen wholesome qualities. this, bhikkhus, is called the faculty of energy.” 精进根 viriyindriya sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 精进根 精进 进根 viriyindriya

nodes.title: 念根
nodes.s: v4m-114-念根 念根 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn48.10 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘katamañca , bhikkhave, satindriyaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā. so kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ; vedanāsu…pe… citte…pe… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, satindriyaṃ. 诸位比丘，什么是念根？诸位比丘，于此，圣弟子具念，具备最上的念与慧，能忆持、随忆长久以前所作、长久以前所说之事。他于身随观身而住，热勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于受……于心……于法随观法而住，热勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧。诸位比丘，这被称为念根。 “and what, bhikkhus, is the faculty of mindfulness? here, bhikkhus, a noble disciple is mindful, endowed with supreme maturity of mindfulness, one who remembers and recollects again and again what was done and said long ago. he dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure in the world. he dwells contemplating feelings in feelings... he dwells contemplating mind in mind... he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure in the world. this, bhikkhus, is called the faculty of mindfulness.” 念根 satindriya sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 念根 satindriya

nodes.title: 定根
nodes.s: v4m-115-定根 定根 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn48.10 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘katamañca, bhikkhave, samādhindriyaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ. so vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, samādhindriyaṃ. 诸位比丘，什么是定根？诸位比丘，于此，圣弟子以涅槃为所缘而得定，得心一境性。他远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻有伺，具足并安住于由远离所生的喜、乐的初禅。寻、伺寂灭故，内得净信，心专一性，无寻无伺，具足并安住于由定所生的喜、乐的第二禅。又因离喜，他住于舍，具念、正知，以身感受乐，具足并安住于第三禅，对此，圣者们宣说：‘舍者，具念，乐住。’舍乐、舍苦故，以及先前喜、忧已灭没故，不苦不乐，舍念清净，具足并安住于第四禅。诸位比丘，这被称为定根。 “and what, bhikkhus, is the faculty of concentration? here, bhikkhus, a noble disciple, making relinquishment his object, attains concentration, attains one-pointedness of mind. he, secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and dwells in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by applied and sustained thought, with rapture and happiness born of seclusion. with the stilling of applied and sustained thought, he enters and dwells in the second jhāna, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without applied and sustained thought, and has rapture and happiness born of concentration. with the fading away of rapture, he dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending, and experiences happiness with the body; he enters and dwells in the third jhāna, of which the noble ones declare: 'equanimous and mindful, he dwells happily.' with the abandoning of happiness and pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and displeasure, he enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither painful nor pleasant and has the purification of mindfulness through equanimity. this, bhikkhus, is called the faculty of concentration.” 定根 samādhindriya sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 定根 samadhindriya

nodes.title: 慧根
nodes.s: v4m-116-慧根 慧根 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn48.10 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘katamañca , bhikkhave, paññindriyaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya, sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā. so ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paññindriyaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcindriyānī’’ti. dasamaṃ. “比丘们，什么是慧根？比丘们，于此，圣弟子有智慧，他具足了导向（苦的）生起与灭尽、圣、决择、正向苦尽的智慧。他如实了知‘这是苦’，如实了知‘这是苦的集起’，如实了知‘这是苦的灭尽’，如实了知‘这是导向苦灭的道’——比丘们，这称为慧根。比丘们，这些是五根。”第十。 “and what, bhikkhus, is the faculty of wisdom? here, bhikkhus, a noble disciple is wise, endowed with wisdom that comprehends arising and passing away, which is noble, penetrative, and rightly leads to the destruction of suffering. he knows as it really is: 'this is suffering.' he knows as it really is: 'this is the origin of suffering.' he knows as it really is: 'this is the cessation of suffering.' he knows as it really is: 'this is the path leading to the cessation of suffering.' this, bhikkhus, is called the faculty of wisdom. these, indeed, bhikkhus, are the five faculties.” the tenth. 慧根 paññindriya sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 慧根 pannindriya

nodes.title: 信力
nodes.s: v4m-117-信力 信力 修习框架与能力 atomic_member sn48.43 大品（相应部） mahāvaggapāḷi(saṃyutta) ‘‘katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti? yañca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa uttarante udakaṃ, yañca dakkhiṇante udakaṃ – ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti. evameva kho, bhikkhave, yaṃ saddhindriyaṃ taṃ saddhābalaṃ, yaṃ saddhābalaṃ taṃ saddhindriyaṃ; yaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ taṃ vīriyabalaṃ, yaṃ vīriyabalaṃ taṃ vīriyindriyaṃ; yaṃ satindriyaṃ taṃ satibalaṃ , yaṃ satibalaṃ taṃ satindriyaṃ; yaṃ samādhindriyaṃ taṃ samādhibalaṃ, yaṃ samādhibalaṃ taṃ samādhindriyaṃ; yaṃ paññindriyaṃ taṃ paññābalaṃ, yaṃ paññābalaṃ taṃ paññindriyaṃ. pañcannaṃ, bhikkhave, indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti. tatiyaṃ. “比丘们，是何理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流呢？比丘们，那岛屿北端的水，以及南端的水——比丘们，此即是理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流。同样地，比丘们，信根即是信力，信力即是信根；精进根即是精进力，精进力即是精进根；念根即是念力，念力即是念根；定根即是定力，定力即是定根；慧根即是慧力，慧力即是慧根。比丘们，比丘修习、多修习这五根，由于诸漏已尽，便能于现法中亲自证知、现证无漏的心解脱、慧解脱而住。”第三经。 “and what, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’? the water, bhikkhus, at the northern end of that island and the water at the southern end—this, indeed, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’. in this very same way, bhikkhus, that which is the faculty of faith is the power of faith; that which is the power of faith is the faculty of faith. that which is the faculty of energy is the power of energy; that which is the power of energy is the faculty of energy. that which is the faculty of mindfulness is the power of mindfulness; that which is the power of mindfulness is the faculty of mindfulness. that which is the faculty of concentration is the power of concentration; that which is the power of concentration is the faculty of concentration. that which is the faculty of wisdom is the power of wisdom; that which is the power of wisdom is the faculty of wisdom. bhikkhus, due to having developed and frequently practiced the five faculties, a bhikkhu, through the destruction of the taints, dwells having attained the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom, having realized it for himself with direct knowledge in this very life.” the third. 信力 saddhābala sn48.10 an4.14 sn51.20 sn48.43 信力 saddhabala

nodes.title: 无常相
nodes.s: v4m-122-无常相 无常相 观察、洞见与转向 atomic_member an9.36 九集 navakanipātapāḷi ‘‘dutiyampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, jhānaṃ nissāya…pe… tatiyampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, jhānaṃ nissāya… ‘catutthampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati – ‘etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbāna’nti. so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā. “诸比丘，我依止第二禅……乃至……我依止第三禅……乃至……‘诸比丘，我依止第四禅而说诸漏的灭尽。’此话是这样说的，此乃依何而说呢？诸比丘，于此，有比丘舍乐、舍苦，先已灭除喜、忧，进入并安住于不苦不乐、舍念清净的第四禅。他对其中所有色、受、想、行、识等法，皆观为无常、苦、病、痈、箭、灾、疾、他、坏、空、无我。他令心于彼等法生起厌离。他令心于彼等法生起厌离后，将心导向不死界：‘此乃寂静，此乃殊胜，即一切行之止息，一切依之舍离，爱尽、离贪、灭、涅槃。’他安住于此，便证得诸漏灭尽。若未证得诸漏灭尽，则因对彼法之贪与喜，五下分结断尽，成为化生者，于彼界般涅槃，不复从彼世间返回。” ‘bhikkhus, i declare the destruction of the taints by relying on the second jhāna… and so on… by relying on the third jhāna… ‘bhikkhus, i declare the destruction of the taints by relying on the fourth jhāna.’ indeed, this was said. and in reference to what was it said? here, bhikkhus, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and displeasure, a bhikkhu enters and abides in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. he thoroughly contemplates whatever phenomena are comprised therein—included in form, feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness—as impermanent, as suffering, as a disease, as a boil, as a dart, as misery, as an affliction, as alien, as disintegrating, as empty, as not-self. he turns his mind away from those phenomena. having turned his mind away from them, he directs his mind to the deathless element: ‘this is peaceful, this is sublime, namely, the stilling of all formations, the relinquishing of all substrates of existence, the destruction of craving, dispassion, cessation, nibbāna.’ established therein, he attains the destruction of the taints. if he does not attain the destruction of the taints, then through that very passion for the dhamma and that delight in the dhamma, with the utter destruction of the five lower fetters, he is one of spontaneous birth, who will attain final nibbāna there, not subject to returning from that world. 无常 anicca sn22.59 an9.36 无常 anicca

nodes.s: v4m-124-无我相 无我相 观察、洞见与转向 atomic_member sn22.59 蕴品 khandhavaggapāḷi ‘‘vedanā anattā. vedanā ca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca vedanāya – ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’ti. yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, vedanā anattā, tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati , na ca labbhati vedanāya – ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’’’ti. “诸比丘，受是无我。诸比丘，如果此受是我，此受就不会导向病痛，并且能在受上得遂所愿：‘愿我的受是这样，愿我的受不是这样。’诸比丘，正因为受是无我，所以受导向病痛，并且不能在受上得遂所愿：‘愿我的受是这样，愿我的受不是这样。’” “bhikkhus, feeling is not-self. if, bhikkhus, feeling were self, this feeling would not lead to affliction, and it would be possible to have one's way with feeling: ‘let my feeling be thus; let my feeling not be thus.’ but because, bhikkhus, feeling is not-self, therefore feeling leads to affliction, and it is not possible to have one's way with feeling: ‘let my feeling be thus; let my feeling not be thus.’” 无我 anattā sn22.59 an9.36 无我 anatta
